reference_sql:
SELECT store_code, EXTRACT(year FROM age(DATE '2026-01-05', opened_on)) AS whole_years
FROM stores
WHERE close_date IS NULL
alternatives: SELECT store_code, date_sub('year', opened_on, DATE '2026-01-05') AS whole_years FROM stores WHERE close_date IS NULL

SELECT store_code, 2026 - EXTRACT(year FROM opened_on) - CASE WHEN EXTRACT(month FROM opened_on) * 100 + EXTRACT(day FROM opened_on) > 105 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS whole_years FROM stores WHERE close_date IS NULL

other_way.sql: SELECT store_code, 2026 - EXTRACT(year FROM opened_on) - CASE WHEN EXTRACT(month FROM opened_on) * 100 + EXTRACT(day FROM opened_on) > 105 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS whole_years FROM stores WHERE close_date IS NULL
other_way.tradeoff: Comparing the month and day by hand shows the anniversary rule, but age() gives the whole years in one call.

planted_wrong.sql: SELECT store_code, date_diff('year', opened_on, DATE '2026-01-05') AS whole_years FROM stores WHERE close_date IS NULL
SELECT store_code, date_diff('year', opened_on, DATE '2026-01-05') - 1 AS whole_years FROM stores WHERE close_date IS NULL
